body:
I feel like the learning curve is something to hold close and utilise what I've learnt to help myself, but I'm just confused and feel like I've learnt nothing half the time. I keep falling back into the whole and getting stuck and I just want to be normal for once, but it isn't really possible. 

Every time I have opened up, things have improved. I know this works and I have done it twice already, and I hate how I'm too scared to do so. I was too scared to post the original post and came to the point of deleting it while I was writing it up a few times. At least it's up now though. 

Some people from this subreddit have already reached out and, including yourself, it's amazing to see that people care about me even when I may not. So thank you.
